text_block_list.text:
Hearing some kind of bizarre chanting (?) leaking out,
I peeked into the waiting room...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: S　P　I　N　A　C　H　!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Phew... My heart was pounding so hard,
I was chanting prayers even more than usual!
choice_data_list: You're fully fired up, aren't you.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'll show off all this motivation, courage, and good luck
in the race!
